items.title: Solana Schedules Final Cut to 200-Millisecond Slots
items.summary: Per-block computing limits shrink to preserve overall capacity, while validators face more frequent voting and shorter production windows.

items.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
items.summary: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.

items.title: AI Startup Manus Raises $500 Million After China Nixed Meta’s $2 Billion Acquisition
items.summary: Manus built a self-driving AI assistant before the hype, sold itself to Meta, then watched Beijing unwind the deal.
